name: AnymeX+ β (Beta)
subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.name: AnymeX+ β
apps.subtitle: AnymeX+ beta builds
apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+5

- TV app: sync key reaches a TV that reconnected by itself, highlight on buttons, Home without the phone
  - A TV that reconnected from its saved connection (stage 1) never had the sync key, and the phone said to tap the TV in a list that isn't shown while connected. The phone now reopens the TV app over LG's link with the key by itself (once per connection; Sync now tries again); the TV then asks for the sync.
  - The highlight didn't show on the Search / Refresh / Settings buttons, stream and track lists: their own style came later and won. Highlight rules now come last.
  - The TV opens on Home whenever a phone has been paired before, and stays there when the phone goes away, also before the first sync.
